newsitem.title: UK: Kleinwort downgrades Barclays - mkt source.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort downgrades Barclays - mkt source.

text.p: Analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson have downgraded Barclays Bank Plc to a "hold" from a "buy" position, market sources said on Monday.
The downgrade came into effect this session. The reason given by market players for the move was that the shares had already had a very strong run and were seen near to their peak.
"The feeling is the stock, and perhaps the sector, has performed strongly and reached its target level," said a market source.
There was no change in Kleinwort's forecast or any fundamental reasons behind the change, said one market source.
Kleinwort's shares were down 26 pence at 1259.
